limitations: Passive observation only; no larger-pool A/B or throughput improvement was implemented in this task.
GPU utilization measures kernel-active time, not fraction of peak FLOPs; memory utilization measures read/write-active time, not exact bandwidth saturation.
nvidia-smi covers the whole device including display workloads. One-second sampling can miss shorter memory/utilization peaks.
Existing 15-second heartbeat phase samples are sparse; the one-second phase_hint can lag up to 15 seconds and is not used for per-phase utilization.
Capacity estimates scale only fixed KV storage with game slots, hold other costs constant, and exclude extra activations, allocator reserve, new graphs and historical-policy overhead.
Recent PPO actor optimizer counts vary because of KL early stopping; this passive window is not a matched-work performance comparison.
ETA extrapolation includes snapshot/log time occurring between recent update records, but has no formal evaluation, full save or late-stage historical/sliding-window overhead.
